comparison.objective: Level a floor sleeper by inserting a tapered shim under its low end.
comparison.physical_skill: Incremental wedge insertion, height feedback, and full-bearing alignment.
comparison.success_condition: Sleeper level within 1 mm, shim fully bearing, level left on top, parts stable, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests precision adjustment by wedge insertion rather than loose-body sorting through apertures.
